rules.conflict_note: Duplicate of X007 record for the same instrument; this one carries the citation and the proposed cap formula (lesser of CPI or 5%).
rules.interaction: State ban on local rent control (M.G.L. c.40P) remains in place.
rules.title: Massachusetts statewide rent cap ballot question (struck)
rules.key_value: failed: proposed cap on annual rent increases not on ballot
rules.requirement: In Cella v. Attorney General (SJC-13893) the SJC held Initiative Petition 25-21, which would have repealed M.G.L. c.40P and capped annual rent increases at the lesser of CPI or 5%, cannot appear on the November 2026 ballot because its religious-use exemption bars it under Article 48.
rules.quoted_span: involved Initiative Petition 25-21, titled “An Initiative Petition to Protect Tenants by Limiting Rent Increases.”

notes: Adds IP 25-21 citation and proposed cap detail not in X007; consolidator should merge with X007 record.
